checks.evidence: [Düzeltildi] PBD verisi alındığında hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması, step 1: OBU processes the PBD data and computes a new speed restriction. It does not mention the permitted speed in the restriction equalling the computed value V1, so the match is partial but acceptable.

Girdi değiştiğinde yeniden hesaplamanın yapılması, step 2: OBU recomputes the speed restriction from the changed input and applies the updated value. It does not name the specific input (emergency brake confidence level via National Values), but the behaviour is equivalent.

invented: Recomputation events are expected to be logged in the system logs
The computed restriction is expected to appear on the driver interface or in system logs
Slope or gradient, vehicle weight and a shorter braking distance are given as example inputs
An OBU internal speed sensor and brake system simulation is assumed to be active
